title: useRef
description:
## useRef

`useRef` gives you a **mutable box** whose `.current` value sticks around between renders — and updating it does **not** trigger a re-render.

The most common job: grab a DOM node so you can call imperative APIs like `focus()`, `scrollIntoView()`, or `play()`.

### Pattern
```jsx
const inputRef = useRef(null);

// 1. Attach the ref
<input ref={inputRef} />

// 2. Use the node
inputRef.current.focus();
```

### Your Task
Build a search bar that focuses programmatically:
1. Create a ref with `useRef(null)`
2. Attach it to the `<input id="search">`
3. Wire `<button id="focus-btn">` so clicking it focuses the input
